The design is notable for packaging small arithmetic and hashing functions behind a standard I2C Pmod interface.

results.summary_before: This project presents an 8-bit prefix network-based high-speed adder that was automatically designed using a large language model to achieve a trade-off between power, performance, and area. The design uses specialized modules for carry and sum generation, and it is tested by exhaustively applying all 8-bit input combinations and verifying the sum against expected results. No external hardware is required. The notable aspect is the use of an LLM to generate a novel prefix network for the adder.

results.summary_before: This design implements a spiking neural network with 18 programmable digital LIF neurons and 144 synapses arranged in three fully connected layers. It is configured via an SPI interface to set neuron thresholds, decay rates, refractory periods, and synaptic weights and delays. Input spikes are applied to the first layer, and output spikes or membrane potentials can be read back through SPI. The project is notable for being generated by ChatGPT and for its use of programmable delays, though no silicon test results are provided.

results.summary_before: This design is an SPI-controlled PWM generator with eight bidirectional IO pins. It contains eight registers accessible via two different SPI interfaces (clocked and sampled) to configure PWM on-time and cycle, as well as IO direction and values. The design includes test modes for SPI reads/writes, PWM output, external PWM control, and bidirectional IO. It requires an external SPI master for configuration and testing.
